title: Two Missing Wires
story: Both the feed from the left rail and the switch wire are missing. Connect them without leaving any floating terminals.
concept: Every device terminal must be connected into a closed circuit. Floating terminals cannot conduct power.

learn.title: Floating Terminals
learn.text: If a terminal has no wire attached, current cannot enter or exit. The checker detects floating terminals immediately.

tests.name: Lamp lights up with button held

steps.explanation: Lamp must turn ON when button is pressed.
Lamp must turn OFF on button release.

hints: Wire the left rail (L) to the left side of START.
Wire the right side of START to the left side of LAMP.
Check that neither terminal on START or LAMP is pulsing red.
